mapper.select: SELECT set_config('app.tenant_id', CAST(#{tenantId} AS TEXT), true)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tenants (id, display_name, tenant_status, expires_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{row.id}, #{row.displayName}, #{row.status}, #{row.expiresAt}, #{row.createdAt}, #{row.updatedAt})

INSERT INTO tenant_creation_idempotency (caller_identity_id, idempotency_key, request_fingerprint, tenant_id, expires_at) VALUES (#{row.callerIdentityId}, #{row.idempotencyKey}, #{row.requestFingerprint}, #{row.tenantId}, #{row.expiresAt}) ON CONFLICT (caller_identity_id, idempotency_key) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT caller_identity_id AS callerIdentityId, idempotency_key AS idempotencyKey, request_fingerprint AS requestFingerprint, tenant_id AS tenantId, response_status AS responseStatus, response_body::TEXT AS responseBody, completed_at AS completedAt, expires_at AS expiresAt FROM tenant_creation_idempotency WHERE caller_identity_id = #{callerIdentityId} AND idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tenant_access_outbox_events (event_id, tenant_id, occurred_at, topic, ordering_key, trace_id, event_snapshot, next_attempt_at) VALUES (#{row.eventId}, #{row.tenantId}, #{row.occurredAt}, #{row.topic}, #{row.orderingKey}, #{row.traceId}, CAST(#{row.eventSnapshot} AS JSONB), #{row.occurredAt})
